name: Procurement - Purchase Order Approval

parameters.query: SELECT po.id, po.po_number, po.total_amount, po.currency, po.vendor_id, v.name as vendor_name, po.pr_id FROM pro_purchase_orders po JOIN pro_vendors v ON v.id = po.vendor_id WHERE po.id = $1 AND po.tenant_id = $2 AND po.status = 'DRAFT';
UPDATE pro_purchase_orders SET status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL', submitted_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1;
SELECT mattermost_user_id FROM pro_approvers WHERE tenant_id = $1 ORDER BY level DESC LIMIT 1;
